scope: Final hr-024 completion: shared CLI/dashboard recovery projection, exact-operation reconciliation and owned stage compare-and-swap, qualified together with previous controller migrations.

dockerRecovery.provider: local deterministic fixture; empty fixture credentials; no network model request

criteria.proof: Reservations precede callbacks; checkpoints bind their producing dispatch; returned execution never implies passing task evidence. Recovery/status preserve interruption and domain priority.
Existing command adapters use owned workflow controllers/stores; domain schemas and dedicated approval/application boundaries remain compatible.

Expected ID/revision and private exact-byte receipts reject stale actions. Stage/continuation/preparation/team/run effects carry operation identity. Two competing recoveries produce one new owner; CLI/dashboard agree on domain recovery priority.

Legacy records and journals remain readable without status writes. Interrupted reservations remain uncertain. New reconciliation and touched staging safety code are formatted; journal recovery does not manufacture missing historical facts.

Real process death and competing prepare/repair, continue/work, stage/apply and team/work commands; exact checkpoint replay, stale review refusal, concurrent recovery and installed Docker interrupted-work trials. One writer and retained durable outcome; no automatic approval.

limitations: Status uses two matching bounded domain reads, not a transaction lock. A copied command rereads state under its writer; the status fingerprint is not permission or verification evidence.

Explicit operation recovery records interruption without applying source, changing approvals or marking tasks complete. Outstanding worker/application recovery blocks it. Unknown worker cleanup remains operator-attended.

Operation and domain publications remain separate durable writes; missing pins cannot grant application approval. Multi-file application and preparation migrations retain their original intent/marker recovery.
Standalone team journals outside managed project directories retain their local serialized compatibility store rather than inventing a project operation ID.
This completes hr-024, not autonomous build guarantees or the full program. hr-025 through hr-045 remain, including structured/noninteractive commands, cumulative budgets and bounded continuation.

No live blog state, credential changes, paid model requests, new dependencies or external publication. Installed runtime qualification is Linux arm64 Docker/Chromium; it does not qualify other platforms.
